mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY ( COMPLAIN_ID, DELEGATE_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, APPROVAL_STATUS_CD, APPROVER_TYPE_CD, PROCESS_DT, APPROVAL_COMMENT, URL ) VALUES ( #{complainId}, #{delegateId}, #{accountId}, #{approvalStatusCd}, #{approverTypeCd}, SYSDATE, #{approvalComment}, #{url} )
mapper.select:
SELECT T1.COMPLAIN_ID, T1.DELEGATE_ID, T1.ACCOUNT_ID, T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD, T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD, T1.PROCESS_DT, T1.APPROVAL_COMMENT, T1.SEQ_NO, T1.URL,
T3.CATEGORY_CD, TC1.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
TC2.CODE_NAME AS APPROVAL_STATUS_NAME, TC3.CODE_NAME AS APPROVER_TYPE_NAME,
TU.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME
FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY T1
INNER JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN T2 ON T1.COMPLAIN_ID = T2.COMPLAIN_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN_CATEGORY T3 ON T2.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID = T3.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC1 ON T3.CATEGORY_CD = TC1.CODE_ID AND TC1.GROUP_ID = 'G0'
LEFT OUTER JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC2 ON T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = TC2.CODE_ID AND TC2.GROUP_ID = 'E0'
LEFT OUTER JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC3 ON T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD = TC3.CODE_ID AND TC3.GROUP_ID = 'F0'
LEFT OUTER JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT TA ON T1.ACCOUNT_ID = TA.ACCOUNT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN T1000_USER TU ON TA.USER_NO = TU.USER_NO
WHERE T1.complain_id = #{complainId} AND T1.seq_no = #{seqNo}
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE complain_id = #{complainId} ORDER BY SEQ_NO ASC, PROCESS_DT ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE complain_id = #{complainId} ORDER BY SEQ_NO DESC, PROCESS_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT T1.COMPLAIN_ID, T1.DELEGATE_ID, T1.ACCOUNT_ID, T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD, T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD, T1.PROCESS_DT, T1.APPROVAL_COMMENT, T1.SEQ_NO, T1.URL,
T3.CATEGORY_CD,
TC1.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
TC2.CODE_NAME AS APPROVAL_STATUS_NAME,
TC3.CODE_NAME AS APPROVER_TYPE_NAME,
TU.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME
FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY T1
INNER JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN T2 ON T1.COMPLAIN_ID = T2.COMPLAIN_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN_CATEGORY T3 ON T2.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID = T3.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC1 ON T3.CATEGORY_CD = TC1.CODE_ID AND TC1.GROUP_ID = 'G0'
LEFT OUTER JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC2 ON T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = TC2.CODE_ID AND TC2.GROUP_ID = 'E0'
LEFT OUTER JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC3 ON T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD = TC3.CODE_ID AND TC3.GROUP_ID = 'F0'
LEFT OUTER JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT TA ON T1.ACCOUNT_ID = TA.ACCOUNT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN T1000_USER TU ON TA.USER_NO = TU.USER_NO
WHERE T1.COMPLAIN_ID = #{complainId}
ORDER BY T1.SEQ_NO ASC
